artifactType: Independent source-component review of DMG p.225 equipment-field mapping proposals
reviewerRole: Independent release/source reviewer for the original 29 proposals; author, not independent approver, of the separate private replacement tools lead-in.

defaultOrderWordingAddendum.reviewResult: accepted: exact three before/after page-group orders, catalog hashes and append-only statements match independent calculations; stale original sentence is explicitly superseded.

method.sourceReading: Viewed independently rendered actual canonical PDF225, all 26 unique proposed physical-row overlays one image per result, both tools passage overlays and raw old lead-in, and the shared right-column interpretation crop.
method.actualCropReplay: All four distinct proposed existing source images replay pixel-for-pixel from canonical PDF225. Explicit point bounds at 216 dpi for table/right context, declared normalized page bounds at 180 dpi for the two older tools crops. RGB, no alpha; MuPDF store cleared before every render.
method.sourceInterpretation: The source column means encumbrance expressed in gold pieces. The explanatory paragraph explicitly combines weight and relative bulkiness; these are neither purchase prices nor literal object weights. Existing gp-weight field wording is not expanded into a physical weight equivalence.
method.markers: All 26 target rows were checked individually. No target row carries a marker; the musical-instrument asterisk and its footnote remain visible and are not inherited by adjacent target rows.
method.ownership: All 29 current full assembled owner objects, field values and exact pending bindings were checked; owner objects equal their actual frozen 1000-route snapshot source records. This is a source-record comparison, not a fresh route sweep.
method.limits: The root report’s 64-row classification is retained as prior evidence; this review does not independently re-audit all other source rows, approve numeric grades or assert whole-book completeness.

checks.name: 4572 actual field bindings, including 29 exact DMG225 target fields pending
all 29 owners, values, actual before bindings, source identities, catalog/PNG/focus/content hashes and field-specific owner links match proposal
three candidate catalogs preserve whole old catalogs and append only row and meaning-context aliases; selected defaults stable and ordered group hashes change
all 26 row overlay bytes match manifest and physical row denominator
all 29 complete owner objects equal actual frozen 1000-route snapshot records; every shared physical-row focus is identical to inspected overlay

harnessCalibration.failureExplanation: The independent harness initially deep-compared the four computed page-order fields to an author object additionally containing three explicit pending/preservation annotations. The four actual fields already matched. The final harness compares exactly those four fields and separately asserts all three annotations; no source, proposal, candidate or expected hash was changed.

catalogAndDefaultScope.candidateCatalogAdditions: Only two regions append to each of the Lantern, Mirror and Spike private catalogs; unchanged selected default IDs do not transfer a prior default assessment to the changed whole-group hash.
catalogAndDefaultScope.fieldEvidenceOrder: Row(s) then meaning context; tools lead-in then list item. These field-specific selections are assessed; this does not approve every old region in a page-default group.

confirmedUnappliedDefects.findings: Incidental printed folio is clipped at the bottom-right image boundary; the crop begins amid the preceding instrument footnote. Complete relevant exclusion lead-in and its focus remain legible. Exact source replay does not clear this crop defect.
confirmedUnappliedDefects.defaultAssessment: withheld; whole ordered default group not approved

replacementToolsLeadInAuthorProposal.authorActualImageInspection: Raw crop and exact proposed overlay viewed. Complete two-line lead-in retained; preceding unrelated fragment and clipped folio excluded. This author inspection is not an independent approval.
replacementToolsLeadInAuthorProposal.oldRegionPolicy: Old ID, pixels and confirmed crop defect stay traceable. Proposed new field-specific region must not silently clear the old warning.
